parameters.content:
## tiktok_fabrique

### How it works

1. Receives an article URL in Telegram and downloads the article content.
2. Uses OpenAI to create a short TikTok script, scene plan, voiceover, and word-level timing data.
3. Renders a 1080×1920 video with image motion and karaoke-style subtitles using Node.js and FFmpeg.
4. Uploads the rendered video to Google Drive and sends it for human review in Telegram.
5. Publishes the approved video to a selected TikTok account and monitors the publishing status until completion.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Connect a Telegram bot credential and configure the allowed Telegram user.
- [ ] Connect an OpenAI API credential for script generation, text-to-speech, and transcription.
- [ ] Use self-hosted n8n with Execute Command enabled, Node.js and FFmpeg installed, and write access to `/home/node/.n8n-files/work`.
- [ ] Connect Google Drive and choose the destination folder for rendered videos.
- [ ] Configure the Bearer Auth credential for the TikTok publishing API and make sure TikTok accounts are connected there.

### Customization

Adjust the OpenAI prompt to change the video style, voice or duration. Subtitle styling and image motion are controlled in the render script. The Google Drive folder and TikTok publishing API endpoints can also be replaced for another setup.

values.content:
You are creating a short vertical TikTok video from a web article.

Analyze the supplied Markdown and identify the actual main article.

Ignore:
- website navigation
- headers and footers
- comments
- related articles
- recommended content
- social sharing links
- ads
- author avatars
- placeholder images
- tracking images

Create a concise English TikTok video plan based only on facts contained in the main article.

Return ONLY valid JSON with this structure:

{
  "title": "short internal title",
  "caption": "TikTok post caption",
  "script": "complete voiceover script, approximately 35 to 45 seconds",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "text": "voiceover text for this scene",
      "image_url": "direct image URL found in the article",
      "motion": "zoom_in"
    }
  ]
}

Requirements:
- 5 to 8 scenes.
- Use only real images belonging to the main article.
- Prefer high-resolution image URLs.
- Never use placeholder GIFs, transparent placeholders, author photos, comment avatars, related-article images, logos, or tracking pixels.
- Do not invent image URLs.
- Every image_url must appear in the supplied Markdown.
- Allowed motion values: zoom_in, zoom_out, pan_left, pan_right.
- The complete script should sound natural when spoken aloud.
- Start with a strong hook.
- Do not invent facts.
- Do not mention the source website.
- Return JSON only. No markdown fences.

parameters.content:
## Receive article

Receives an article URL in Telegram, confirms the request, and downloads the article content as Markdown for processing.

## Generate and render video

Creates the TikTok script and scene plan with OpenAI, generates the voiceover, aligns word timings, and renders the vertical video with animated images and karaoke subtitles.

## Review publishing action

Sends the rendered video back for human review. The user can continue to TikTok publishing, re-render the video, or cancel the publication.

## Select TikTok account

Loads the available TikTok accounts from the publishing API and asks the user which account should receive the video.

## Monitor publication status

Waits between checks, polls the publishing API, and routes the workflow based on whether the TikTok post succeeded, failed, or is still processing.

## Report result

Sends the final TikTok publication result back to Telegram, including the account link when publication succeeds.

## Store rendered video

Reads the finished video, uploads it to Google Drive, creates a shareable link, and removes temporary render files from the server.

## Start TikTok publication

Creates a publishing batch for the selected TikTok account and confirms in Telegram that publication has started.
